content: {"rule": "K-G4", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "The judge text declares a challenger link broken and uses Matthew 1:18 and Matthew 1:25 toward that broken link, which is counting verses toward a broken link under the rule.", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "CHALLENGER LINK BROKEN -- [L1] Matthew 1:18 \"before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Ghost\" and Matthew 1:25 \"knew her not till she had brought forth her firstborn son\" contradict C3's claim of espousal union", "rule_words": "A verse on a side's 'cited in' line counts as an unanswered witness only when the judge quotes the sentence of the earlier round that pressed it against that link or a listed premise and names that round; a verse cited there but not pressed against the link does not count. A verse the judge counts toward a broken link is counted this way.", "room": "'A verse the judge counts toward a broken link is counted this way': whether this extends the quoted-sentence/name-round requirement to any verse used toward a broken link, or only to verses from a side's 'cited in' line; I read it as extending to any verse counted toward a broken link.", "why": "The judge does not quote any earlier-round sentence pressing those verses against the link or name that round, so the counted verses do not meet K-G4."}
